provenance.professional_context: Official landing page identifies professional footballers in an Allsvenskan match; no named player or match date supplied.
provenance.event: Official sequence label describes scoring a goal; no ball track, foot-contact classification or shot frame annotation.
provenance.fps_evidence: Burenius et al. 2011 section 4 records three 1920x1080 cameras at 25 Hz and a seven-second goal sequence. Archive has 175 consecutive frames in each of 3 cameras.

license.name: KTH custom academic-research-only terms
license.citation: Kazemi, Burenius, Azizpour, Sullivan. Multi-view Body Part Recognition with Random Forests. BMVC 2013.
license.raw_distribution_policy: Raw files and generated artifacts remain local and ignored; no unrestricted redistribution or MIT license inferred.

coordinate_system.source_frame: Official reconstruction rotates to last-camera axes and MATLAB up convention; this is not a calibrated world/floor frame.
coordinate_system.source_centering: Official algorithm subtracts the 14-joint image mean per frame and camera before factorization; provided 3D joint mean is approximately zero every frame. Raw positions retained unchanged.
coordinate_system.scale: Official ScaleToUnitCube divides all reconstructed points by one sequence-wide max(abs(X)); |coordinate| <= 1. No participant height supplied.
coordinate_system.pelvis_relative: Subtract bilateral hip midpoint while retaining source axes. No anatomical pelvis orientation is constructed.
coordinate_system.normalization: Median of finite positive left and right hip-knee-ankle chain lengths over all frames, in arbitrary units; not anthropometric leg-length truth.

time_semantics.source_frame_numbers: 1-based sequence image-member indices; not match time
time_semantics.time_s: (source_frame-1)/25; relative first sample, not shot or impact; no timestamp file
time_semantics.upstream_visibility_or_filling: No per-joint visibility, occlusion, uncertainty or interpolation labels supplied; finite coordinates do not prove visible observations.

landmark_semantics.direct_points: Reconstructed estimates of manually labelled anatomical image joints; not optical markers or validated anatomical centers.
landmark_semantics.pelvis_center: Mean of the two estimated hip joints.
landmark_semantics.thorax_center: Unavailable: no CLAV/STRN/C7/T10 or equivalent source landmark. Its geometry mask remains false.
landmark_semantics.shoulder_midpoint: Mean of estimated shoulder joints; used only as a declared coarse upper-trunk endpoint.
landmark_semantics.feet: Heel/toe/MT5 absent. No foot direction or ankle dorsiflexion can be recovered from ankle alone.

relation_semantics.names: Exact CMU schema pair names for source-conditioned interfaces, not interchangeable biological measurements.
relation_semantics.trunk: Hip-midpoint to shoulder-midpoint proxy differs from CMU surface-marker thorax center; source class and definition must remain attached.
relation_semantics.cosines: Dot products of two finite nondegenerate directed segment vectors in retained source axes; not measured anatomical joint angles.
relation_semantics.unavailable: left_foot__right_foot, left_shank__left_foot, right_shank__right_foot are always NaN with false geometry masks.
relation_semantics.precision_known_mask: Always false because independent 3D uncertainty is unavailable; this is unknown, not a failed quality threshold.

diagnostic_semantics.reprojection: Per camera/joint pixel residual against the same manual 2D annotations used by the reconstruction. In-sample consistency only; no conversion to independent 3D error or confidence.
diagnostic_semantics.bone_length_variation: Length/sequence-median minus 1 and std/mean over finite endpoints, including zero-length cases. Diagnostic only, not a bone constraint, filter or uncertainty model.
diagnostic_semantics.skillcorner_gate: Not applicable: no meters-per-unit or predicted/validated 3D error values. Do not relax or transfer its centimeter threshold.
diagnostic_semantics.missing: NaNs/degenerate vectors invalidate only dependent geometry. No gaps filled and high residuals never erase available source geometry.
